lines.3: 「You have no idea how to handle a woman.」
lines.4: 「Watching you made my meddler's blood start to stir.」
lines.5: 「As principal, I'll take it upon myself to bring the two of you together.」
lines.6: 「Bring us together? It's not like we're--」
lines.7: 「Don't hide it, don't hide it! If you're a man, stand proud!」
lines.8: 「Leave it to me. Next Saturday, was it?」
lines.9: 「Tell the young lady to bring a swimsuit.」
lines.11: 「You too, of course. Meet in front of the school gate at ten.」
lines.12: I was starting to get a bad feeling about this.
lines.13: But he had so much presence I couldn't bring myself to say no!
lines.15: 「Oh, Leo! Heading home? You look so pitiful walking alone, so a spirit-like being such as myself will accompany you.」
lines.17: 「Crab, want a set of ten winning gum coupons?」
lines.18: 「YEAH! And even if you ask for 'em back, you're not getting 'em!」
lines.22: 「I've been judging gifts by YOUR standards this whole time... Hmm.」
